items.titleEn: Delta Cargo places temporary BOS cargo restrictions due to fuel supply disruption
items.factEn: Delta Cargo said an ongoing fuel supply disruption affecting BOS operations led to temporary restrictions through 23:59 EST on September 28, 2026, for all Delta flights to and from BOS. Delta Mainline embargoes all products except DSH, DMD and DHV; Delta Connection embargoes all products.
items.impactEn: Business inference: this affects Delta-carried BOS shipments and may require rerouting or delay. It does not prove BOS airport closure, an all-airline embargo, or a wider Northeast air cargo shutdown.

items.fact: Nairametrics 9月27日报道，Air Peace称ABV初始延误由Jet A1燃油不可用造成，且影响ABV其他航司；燃油可用后受影响航班恢复。其ABV—MIU服务随后因MIU塔台改称机场转为VFR且日落后不再运行而取消，航司称安排次日执行。

items.action: 涉及尼日利亚国内空运或经ABV衔接的货物，向承运人和当地代理核实燃油、可运行时段、次日补班和货站接货安排。
items.titleEn: Air Peace says ABV operations were hit by Jet A1 shortage, with ABV-MIU also affected by post-sunset VFR limits
items.factEn: Nairametrics reported on September 27 that Air Peace said initial ABV delays were caused by unavailable Jet A1 fuel, also affecting other airlines at Abuja. After fuel became available, affected flights resumed. Its ABV-MIU service was then unable to operate because the MIU tower said the airport had become VFR and would not operate beyond sunset; the airline said the cancelled service was arranged for the following day.
items.impactEn: Business inference: Nigerian domestic belly cargo, express and airport connections may be affected by fuel availability and destination airport operating limits. The evidence currently covers Air Peace flights only and should not be expanded to an ABV, MIU or nationwide cargo shutdown.
items.actionEn: For Nigerian domestic air cargo or ABV connections, verify fuel status, operating hours, recovery flight timing and cargo acceptance with the carrier and local agent.

items.titleEn: Thai Airways BKK cargo warehouse suspends intake due to flood-related staffing and backlog issues
items.factEn: The Nation reported on September 30 that Thai Airways suspended inbound and outbound cargo acceptance at its BKK warehouse for seven days, from September 30 to October 6, because flooding disrupted staff attendance and caused warehouse manpower shortages, delivery delays, flight-transfer delays and backlog.
items.impactEn: Business inference: the impact is specific to Thai Airways' BKK warehouse acceptance, release and flight-transfer handling. It does not mean BKK airport is closed or that other airlines' cargo terminals have imposed the same stop. A separate search result suggested the suspension may have been removed, so live acceptance must be verified with the carrier or terminal.
items.actionEn: For TG cargo via BKK, verify booking validity, current warehouse acceptance, alternative GHA/carrier options, and release or onward-transfer arrangements for cargo already tendered.

items.fact: Expeditors 9月30日更新称，当前空域报告未显示中东出现广泛区域空域关闭或重大航班运行变化，但受影响区域仍可能有战术绕飞、流控、GPS干扰和短通知调整。页面列出伊朗空域关闭、卡塔尔空域部分关闭、KWI等地限制，以及多家航司中东航线仍处限制或暂停状态。
items.impact: 业务推断：经海湾、中东接欧洲/非洲/南亚的货物仍需逐航司和逐航段确认，不能把区域风险扩大为所有中东枢纽关闭，也不能把个别航司恢复写成全网正常。
items.action: 订舱前核对实际承运人、飞越/落地空域、DG/AVI等产品限制、中转确认和目的地清关；对DXB/DWC/DOH/BAH/KWI/BGW等节点保留备选路由。
items.titleEn: Middle East air operations remain affected by airspace, carrier and clearance restrictions, with no broad new closure indicated
items.factEn: Expeditors' September 30 update said current airspace reporting did not indicate a broad regional airspace closure or a major change to flight operations, while tactical routing, flow controls, GPS interference and short-notice schedule changes remain possible. The update listed Iran airspace as closed, Qatar airspace as partially closed, restrictions at KWI and other points, and several carriers with Middle East routes still restricted or suspended.
items.impactEn: Business inference: cargo moving via Gulf and Middle East links to Europe, Africa or South Asia still needs carrier- and sector-level confirmation. The regional risk should not be expanded into a blanket Middle East hub closure, and individual resumptions should not be treated as full network normalization.
items.actionEn: Before booking, verify operating carrier, airspace exposure, product restrictions such as DG/AVI, onward transit confirmation and destination clearance; keep backup routings for DXB/DWC/DOH/BAH/KWI/BGW and related nodes.

items.impact: 业务推断：这是北美西岸与日本、台湾、新加坡间的新增大型货机容量线索，可关注科技货和大件货；但属于计划首航，尚不能替代实际订舱确认，也不等于拉美后程已可售。

items.titleEn: NX and JAL plan weekly LAX-NRT-TPE-SIN-NRT-LAX 747F circuit from October 3
items.factEn: NX Group announced on October 1 that it and JAL will launch a transport partnership covering intra-Asia and North America-Asia routes using a 747F secured by JAL through partners. The circuit originates in LAX and routes via NRT, TPE, SIN and NRT back to LAX, with the first flight planned for October 3, 2026 and one weekly flight in 2026. The release says the service targets AI, semiconductor, server rack, data center equipment and other oversized or high-value cargo demand.
items.impactEn: Business inference: this is a new large-freighter capacity lead between the U.S. West Coast, Japan, Taiwan and Singapore, relevant for technology and oversized cargo. It remains a planned launch and does not replace booking confirmation or prove sellable Latin America onward capacity.
items.actionEn: Confirm first-flight operation, sales channel, available weight and positions, special-cargo limits, LAX tender point and handling rules at each Asian stop with NX/JAL; verify any Latin America onward leg separately.

items.titleEn: American Airlines Cargo applies temporary product restrictions during aacargo.com upgrade
items.factEn: American Airlines Cargo says it is applying temporary operational restrictions for flights between September 30 and October 12 during its aacargo.com upgrade. For bookings from October 1 to 3 covering flights from October 1 to 12, Critical PPS and EZBook are fully restricted, while AVI, HR and regulated DG are partially restricted. The page states restrictions will be lifted for the booking window from October 4 onward.
items.impactEn: Business inference: the impact is limited to AA-carried products and defined booking/flight windows, and may require date, product or carrier changes. It does not indicate U.S. airport closure or a blanket AA general-cargo embargo.
items.actionEn: For AA AVI, HR, DG, Critical PPS and EZBook shipments, check both booking date and flight date against the restriction windows and confirm acceptable products and alternatives with AA sales.

items.fact: IAG Cargo 10月1日更新称，自10月6日起分阶段调整纸质货运单证流程：10月6日先适用于Asia Pacific、India、Middle East、North America和Latin America；10月20日适用于United Kingdom和Africa；10月27日适用于Europe、Caribbean和Rest of the World。已电子提交且符合条件的eAWB、eCSD、FHL、eDGD等不应再提供纸质副本；部分正本文件仍需随货。
items.impact: 业务推断：这会影响交货文件准备和现场收运流程，但不是航班、舱位或机场运行变化；不符合电子路径资格的货件仍可能需要纸质转换或随货原件。
items.action: 使用IAG Cargo前按起运地生效日期核对航线和单证资格，提前完成eAWB/eCSD/FHL/eDGD提交，并确认HR、AVI、植检/卫生证书、ATA单证册等正本随货要求。
items.titleEn: IAG Cargo to phase in paperless shipment documentation process
items.factEn: IAG Cargo updated its operational alerts on October 1, saying it will introduce paper shipment documentation changes in phases from October 6. Asia Pacific, India, Middle East, North America and Latin America start on October 6; the United Kingdom and Africa on October 20; and Europe, Caribbean and Rest of the World on October 27. For eligible paperless routes, customers should not provide physical copies of documents already submitted electronically, including eAWB, eCSD, FHL and eDGD, while some original documents still need to travel with the shipment.
items.impactEn: Business inference: this affects tender documentation and station acceptance workflow, not flight operations, capacity or airport status. Shipments that are not eligible for electronic routes may still require paper conversion or original documents with cargo.
items.actionEn: Before using IAG Cargo, check the origin implementation date and route eligibility, submit eAWB/eCSD/FHL/eDGD in advance, and confirm original-document requirements for HR, AVI, phytosanitary/health certificates and carnets.

items.titleEn: JAL launches NRT-LAX 747F codeshare with Atlas Air from October 2
items.factEn: JAL Group announced its FY2026 winter international cargo network on October 1, stating that from October 2 it will launch new Narita-Los Angeles codeshare operations using 747 freighters in partnership with Atlas Air. items.titleEn: WorldACD report cited by CAAS: global tonnage down 4% before Golden Week, Asia Pacific weakest while prices keep rising
items.factEn: CAAS cited WorldACD on October 5 as saying global chargeable weight fell 4% week on week in the latest reporting period, with all origin regions except Africa declining and Asia Pacific down the most at 7%. Global average prices rose 2%, with Asia Pacific up 4%, Africa, Europe and MESA up 3% each, and North America unchanged. The report said China’s October 1-7 Golden Week would continue to affect export volumes.
items.impactEn: PUBLIC-PROXY / LAGGING-BACKGROUND: this is a regional sample-based market indicator and holiday-period context, not proof of sellable space or executable +1000 kg rates from any specific China airport. Asia-to-Europe and Asia-to-U.S. volume and price signals are mixed and need origin- and cargo-specific quoting.
items.actionEn: When using the trend, retain the WorldACD sample and observation-period caveat. Reconfirm capacity and rates for China, Hong Kong, Taiwan and Southeast Asia exports to Europe or the U.S. by origin airport, carrier, date, product and cargo type.

items.titleEn: Leeds Bradford airport staff plan two strike days from October 16 to 18
items.factEn: ITV reported on October 5 that around 130 Leeds Bradford Airport staff plan to strike over pay across two days between 03:00 on October 16 and 06:00 on October 18. items.action: 涉及BRU的货物，确认承运航司使用的地服、航班状态、GHA截货和到港提货安排；对10月9日出入港货物保留改配或RFS方案。
items.titleEn: BRU Alyzia ground staff action on October 9 is expected to cause partial flight cancellations
items.factEn: Brussels Airport's official operational communication says that during the Belgian national manifestation on October 9, part of ground handler Alyzia's staff is expected to take part. Based on current information, about half of the flights handled by Alyzia are expected to operate as planned, while some flights will have to be cancelled. Flights handled by Aviapartner are currently not expected to be affected, and the October 12 public-service union action is not expected to affect air traffic.
items.impactEn: Business inference: BRU belly cargo, mail/express and freight using Alyzia ground services may face cancellations, delays and reduced handling manpower. Current evidence does not support saying BRU airport is closed or all cargo terminals have stopped accepting freight.
items.actionEn: For BRU shipments, confirm the operating airline’s ground handler, flight status, GHA cut-off and arrival release arrangements; keep rerouting or RFS options for October 9 movements.

items.title: Qantas Freight MEL出口ULD临时调整：建议航班前4—6小时交付
items.airports: MEL / Qantas Freight Melbourne Freight Terminal
items.confidence: Qantas Freight官方新闻页可读；未列工程结束日和适用航班清单
items.fact: Qantas Freight 10月7日通知称，因墨尔本货站基础设施升级的准备工程，进口业务不受影响；工程期间出口ULD处理方式临时调整，客户应在航班计划起飞前4—6小时交付出口ULD。因存储能力降低，过早到达的ULD可能不被接受，并可能被要求接近起飞时间再返回。
items.impact: 业务推断：MEL出口BUP/ULD交货窗口变窄，过早交货可能增加二次派车和误截风险；这不是航班取消或进口货物影响通知。
items.action: 涉及Qantas Freight MEL出口ULD，按计划起飞时间倒推4—6小时交付，提前与墨尔本货运操作团队确认接收窗口、排队和特殊货安排。
items.titleEn: Qantas Freight MEL export ULD temporary handling change: deliver 4-6 hours before departure
items.factEn: Qantas Freight notified customers on October 7 that preparatory works for an upcoming infrastructure upgrade at its Melbourne Freight Terminal are temporarily changing export ULD handling. Import operations are not affected. Export ULDs should be delivered 4-6 hours before scheduled flight departure; due to reduced storage capacity, ULDs arriving much earlier may not be accepted and customers may be asked to return closer to departure time.
items.impactEn: Business inference: the MEL export BUP/ULD tender window is narrower, and early tender may create second-truck or missed cut-off risk. This is not a flight cancellation notice or an import-cargo impact notice.
items.actionEn: For Qantas Freight MEL export ULDs, work backward 4-6 hours from scheduled departure and confirm acceptance window, queueing and special-cargo arrangements with Melbourne Freight Operations.

items.title: RUH爆炸后多航司暂停利雅得服务，机场取消大量航班
items.airports: RUH；Najran报道涉及机场但货运影响待核
items.confidence: AP 10月8日可读报道；缺少机场、NOTAM和货运承运人逐班清单
items.fact: AP 10月8日报道，利雅得国际机场附近发生爆炸后，Lufthansa Group旗下航司暂停利雅得航班至10月16日；Air India相关利雅得服务至少暂停至周六，Akasa Air和IndiGo也暂停或取消利雅得服务。报道还引述FlightAware称，King Khalid International Airport当日取消超过275班航班。胡塞武装声称袭击利雅得机场及Najran机场，但沙方未即时确认该说法。
items.impact: 业务推断：RUH相关客机腹舱、快件和中东中转可能受取消、改航和安检/地面延误影响；当前证据不等于RUH货站关闭、所有航司停飞，或所有沙特机场不可用。
items.action: 涉及RUH到离港或经沙特转运的货物，核对实际承运航司、航班状态、是否改降/改配、货站接货和DG/温控等特殊货接受；避免仅按既有班表承诺时效。
items.titleEn: Airlines suspend Riyadh services and many RUH flights are cancelled after explosions
items.factEn: AP reported on October 8 that after explosions near Riyadh's international airport, Lufthansa Group airlines suspended Riyadh flights through October 16; Air India-related Riyadh services were suspended at least through Saturday, and Akasa Air and IndiGo also suspended or cancelled Riyadh service. AP also cited FlightAware as showing more than 275 cancellations that day at King Khalid International Airport. Houthi rebels claimed attacks on Riyadh and Najran airports, but Saudi authorities had not immediately confirmed the claim.
items.impactEn: Business inference: RUH belly cargo, express and Middle East transit may face cancellation, rerouting and security or ground delays. Current evidence does not prove RUH cargo-terminal closure, all-airline suspension, or closure of all Saudi airports.
items.actionEn: For RUH origin, destination or Saudi-transit cargo, verify operating carrier, flight status, diversion or rerouting, cargo-terminal acceptance and special-cargo acceptance such as DG or temperature-controlled freight; do not commit transit time solely from existing schedules.

items.title: 巴拿马地震后PTY短暂停航并宣布重开，货运后程仍需单票确认
items.confidence: AP与Reuters转载均确认PTY先暂停后重开/解除停航；未取得机场货站和航空公司货运恢复清单
items.fact: 10月9日巴拿马南部发生强震及余震。AP报道称，Tocumen International Airport在首次地震后临时暂停运行，周五下午称正在重开。Reuters转载称，巴拿马运河和Cobre Panama报告正常运行，PTY已解除航班暂停。
items.impact: 业务推断：PTY作为中美洲和拉美中转枢纽的客机腹舱、快件和区域中转可能出现改降、延误和错失衔接；机场重开不等于所有货物积压、航班轮转和货站交付已经恢复。
items.action: 涉及PTY中转或巴拿马到离港货物，核对实际航班、是否改降、后续衔接、货站可提/可交状态及易腐、温控、快件优先处理安排。
items.titleEn: PTY briefly suspended operations after Panama earthquakes and then announced reopening; cargo recovery still needs shipment-level checks
items.factEn: Strong earthquakes and aftershocks hit southern Panama on October 9. AP reported that Tocumen International Airport temporarily suspended operations after the first quake and said Friday afternoon it was reopening. A Reuters report carried by MarketScreener said the Panama Canal and Cobre Panama reported normal operations and that PTY had lifted its flight suspension.
items.impactEn: Business inference: PTY belly cargo, express and regional connections may face diversions, delays and missed onward links. Reopening the airport does not prove all cargo backlogs, aircraft rotations and warehouse handovers have normalized.
items.actionEn: For PTY transit or Panama origin/destination cargo, verify actual flight operation, diversion status, onward connection, terminal acceptance or release, and priority handling for perishables, temperature-controlled cargo and express shipments.

items.title: ANA公布10月16日起日本出发国际货物燃油附加费上调
items.airports: 日本出发 / ANA国际货运网络
items.confidence: ANA Cargo英文页面可读；适用以日本出发和AWB签发口径为限
items.fact: ANA Cargo英文国际货运页10月10日读取显示，重要通知列出2026年10月9日发布的日本出发国际货物燃油附加费修订，10月16日起长程TC1/TC2/TC3为198 JPY/kg，长程亚洲TC3为121 JPY/kg，短程亚洲TC3为97 JPY/kg；页面同时列出10月1日起旧标准分别为191、118、95 JPY/kg。
items.impact: 业务推断：日本出发ANA国际货物10月16日起可能出现燃油附加费成本上升；这不是总运价，也不能套用于非日本出发、其他航司或日本中转但非日本签发主单的货物。
items.action: 涉及日本出发ANA货物，按AWB签发日、目的区域、产品和是否已获报价确认附加费；客户报价中区分燃油附加费与主运价。
items.titleEn: ANA posts higher ex-Japan international cargo fuel surcharges from October 16
items.factEn: ANA Cargo's English international cargo page, read on October 10, lists an October 9 notice revising fuel surcharges for international cargo from Japan. From October 16, the page shows 198 JPY/kg for long-distance TC1/TC2/TC3, 121 JPY/kg for long-distance Asia TC3, and 97 JPY/kg for short-distance Asia TC3; the October 1 rates shown on the same page are 191, 118 and 95 JPY/kg respectively.
items.impactEn: Business inference: ANA ex-Japan international cargo may carry higher fuel-surcharge cost from October 16. This is not the total freight rate and should not be applied to non-Japan origins, other airlines, or Japan transit shipments without Japan-issued MAWB applicability.
items.actionEn: For ANA ex-Japan shipments, verify AWB issue date, destination zone, product and quoted surcharge status; separate fuel surcharge from base freight in customer quotes.
